book_title: The Ideology of Pakistan and its Implementation
notes: Each PDF page in this source file is a scanned two-page spread (blank/verso + recto, or recto+verso), not a single physical page. Gold files capture both physical pages in correct reading order (left page complete, then right page complete), separated by a [PAGE <label>] marker. This was discovered during corpus selection (see docs/EVAL_HARNESS.md) and directly informs Phase 2's spread-splitting requirement.

pages.why: Front matter: cursive display type mixed with serif body type, sparse layout, decorative typography stress-test.
Roman-numeral pagination; lettered (a)-(e) list; a word ('subconsciously') split by hyphen exactly at the page boundary -- real cross-page dehyphenation case for Phase 4.
Structured table of contents: chapter titles right-aligned against page numbers, roman + arabic numerals mixed.
Chapter opening: blank verso + chapter heading + first paragraph. Tests blank-page handling and heading detection.
Representative dense body prose, both facing pages fully printed -- the median case this book actually consists of.
Body prose with a footnote reference marker (superscript 1) and a parenthetical aside -- tests footnote-marker handling.
Body prose with two bold run-in subheadings -- tests heading-level detection within a body page (not just chapter openings).
Second chapter-opening example (Chapter 6), confirms blank-verso pattern is systematic, not a one-off.
Body prose with footnote marker 7, a long block quotation, and multiple compound hyphenates (North-West, joint-defence) -- tests that legitimate hyphens are preserved while line-wrap hyphens are not.
Endnotes section: numbered citation list, blank verso. Distinct structural genre from body prose (list, not paragraphs).
Endnotes continuation, both pages full -- multiple 'Chapter N' sub-headings within a single physical page, citation-dense text with quoted titles.

Endnotes tail (left page) + Index start (right page): the right page is a GENUINE two-column layout within one physical page -- the one real intra-page multi-column case in this book, distinct from the spread-splitting issue.
Index tail: mostly blank page containing a small amount of real text plus a hand-drawn circle annotation (non-text ink) -- tests that the pipeline doesn't hallucinate text from marginalia.

Photographed back cover / spine: minimal real text (title + author + call number label) against a textured cloth background -- tests that the pipeline doesn't hallucinate paragraphs from texture noise.
